scheme_name: Construction of Hostels for OBC Boys and Girls
other_conditions: Students must belong to the OBC category as per Central/State/UT lists and must not be part of the creamy layer
Hostel seats are primarily for post‑matric students; pre‑matric secondary students may be admitted if seats are vacant
Preference is given to students from low‑income families
At least 5% of total seats are reserved for students with disabilities
Agencies eligible for financial assistance are State Governments, Union Territory Administrations, and Central autonomous institutions such as Central Universities, IITs, and NITs
benefits_summary: Financial assistance is provided for constructing hostels for OBC students, covering up to 90% of costs (with a higher central share for girls’ hostels) and a one‑time grant of ₹2,500 per seat for furniture/equipment.
